description: Explain what a sloping roof covers over the plan and give one bay's area. DISTILL-CANARY-f59c812b

files.README.md:
# Grisedale Roofing Supplies - estimating

Shared folder for the trade counter.

- roofs/  cards for each roof and bay
- slates/  stock notes from the yard

turns.prompt: A roofer at Grisedale Roofing Supplies is ordering covering for a bay; a sloping roof covers more than the plan area beneath it, in the proportion of the sloping length to the run. Bay RY-44 covers 216 square metres of plan at a pitch of 5 units of rise for every 12 units of run. Give the area of the sloping roof, as a single number in square metres with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
